eligibility: Invited organizer Atlas Sandbox must be confirmed by operator; localhost is development only. Do not inspect invite email automatically.

baseline.legal_sources: three pinned T03 source versions and verified provision/page excerpts
baseline.fact_split: Persist T03 company facts at context v1. Do not preseed a CA customer/residence event into baseline. After CA injection, create immutable context v2 joining trusted company facts with the event-specific natural person/residency/signup data; do not mutate v1. Main trace fixtures represent the after-event graph and need deterministic projection for baseline.

seed_steps: Check connected database name and tenant fictional_demo=true; require explicit operator sandbox confirmation separately. Never print URI or secret values.
Offline validate files/hashes; EJSON deserialize; actual BSON-size checks <=8MiB and raw source <=4MiB; verify local original SHA256.
Apply createCollection/collMod validators then named indexes idempotently; server validationAction error, never bypass validation.
Acquire tenant maintenance guard; pause claims and outbound dispatch. Use separate seed credentials.

Insert foundation records with deterministic UUIDs and current reset_epoch; activate heads only after graph validation. For same fixture and epoch, identical content is no-op; different immutable bytes at same ID is seed_conflict.

Mark seed manifest ready only after referential/hash/count/index checks, then resume worker. Never insert completed-state approval/evaluation fixture as genuine human/model history into live baseline.
reset_steps: Dry-run tenant counts and pending external effects. Check fictional_demo, expected reset_epoch, namespace/database allowlist and no live sending/unknown_delivery records. Block reset if provider outcome is unresolved; do not erase evidence of an already accepted mail.

Quiesce worker and outbound dispatch. Retain tenant record; CAS increments reset_epoch monotonically and sets maintenance state before any deletion. Every worker commit checks epoch, so old results cannot attach to reused IDs.
Delete ONLY this tenant rows from explicit collection catalog, excluding tenants retained guard. No dropDatabase, no shared/public deletion, no credentials or provider-resource deletion.

Reinsert baseline at new reset epoch; rebuild only missing indexes, not shared indexes; verify schema/reference/hash/count checks. Reset preview files may be removed only under tenant-generation-owned output directory.
Publish ready manifest and clear maintenance state; new runs claim new generation. Human approvals must be collected again. Provider keys include reset epoch.
negative_and_unknown_fixtures: All 11 T03 fixtures plus T07 frozen suite must have isolated deterministic scenario namespaces/tenants; do not overwrite positive facts. Unknown remains null+knowledge unknown, not false/zero.
acceptance: baseline has NY-only customer rows and no CA event
CA injection idempotently creates event/workflow once
founder and lawyer actor assignments correct
provider delivery not invoked by offline seed
